title: Persist official SP638 spline in L_PassoGiauTerrainSpike.umap
hypothesis: The prepared official centerline can be authored and persisted into the isolated Unreal map without mutating canonical route physics.
technical: The isolated .umap was rebuilt and the official SP638 spline persisted.
The resulting map asset was committed by the authoring runner.
visual: Spline existence and persistence were proven; this result alone did not claim acceptable rider-visible world quality.
keep: Isolation of presentation geometry from route physics.
reject: Using spline persistence as a substitute for rider-camera visual acceptance.
learnings: A technically correct map mutation needs a separate visual gate.
next: Capture a cyclist-height proof focused on a representative hairpin.
